measures.title: Heart disease deaths
measures.source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Vital Statistics System
measures.note: Age-adjusted 3-year average death rate for adults ages 35 and older. CDC spatially smooths county rates; the California rate is not smoothed. 'Suppressed' means CDC reports insufficient data.

measures.source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Vital Statistics System
measures.note: Age-adjusted 3-year average death rate for adults ages 35 and older. CDC spatially smooths county rates; the California rate is not smoothed. 'Suppressed' means CDC reports insufficient data.

measures.title: People living below the poverty level
measures.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey (ACS) 5-Year Estimates
measures.note: Percent of people below the federal poverty level. Values marked 'Use with caution' have a coefficient of variation above 30 percent, based on the published margin of error.

measures.title: People without health insurance
measures.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey (ACS) 5-Year Estimates
measures.note: Percent of the civilian noninstitutionalized population without health insurance. Values marked 'Use with caution' have a coefficient of variation above 30 percent, based on the published margin of error.

measures.title: Chronic absenteeism
measures.note: Percent of students absent 10 percent or more of the days they were enrolled. 'Suppressed' means CDE withheld a small number to protect student privacy.

measures.title: Asthma emergency department visits
measures.source: California Department of Public Health (CDPH), California Breathing Asthma Program
measures.note: Age-adjusted emergency department visits with a primary diagnosis of asthma per 10,000 residents. 'Suppressed' means the publisher withheld the value; blank values are statistically unstable.

measures.title: Children and youth receiving specialty mental health services
measures.source: Department of Health Care Services (DHCS), Behavioral Health Program Performance Data
measures.note: Number of Medi-Cal members ages 0 to 20 with 1 or more specialty mental health services (SMHS) in the fiscal year. DHCS publishes counts, so there is no California comparison. 'Suppressed' means DHCS withheld a small number to protect privacy.
